predecessors.name: Han dynasty
predecessors.text: Hanyang Commandery, where the Han army was defeated

successors.name: Han dynasty
successors.text: Hanyang and Longxi in the Liang Province, the Qiang rebels' ground

rulers.name: Dianlian
rulers.title: chieftain of the Xianlian, proclaimed emperor after Hanyang

ledger.x: 107: the war with the Han opens.
118: the First Great Qiang Rebellion is over.
118: Hanyang and Longxi return to the Han.
118: the Qiang state of Dianlian and Lianchang ends: 'quelled in 118'.

wars.name: First Great Qiang Rebellion
wars.outcome: The Qiang beat the Han at Hanyang, took Longxi in 109 and raided Hanzhong in 110; Dianlian died in 112, Lianchang was attacked in 116 and killed in 117; the revolt was quelled in 118.

certainty.note: Only commanderies are named; no frontier.
